title: Compatibility of left indices under extension
statement: For nonnegative integers $r,k$ and an index $j\in\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$, the left paired-coordinate index $r+2j$ among $k+1$ pairs, regarded as an index in the first $r+2k$ coordinates of the larger index set, equals the left paired-coordinate index $r+2j$ among $k$ pairs.
